description: Na₃TmCl₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TmCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-46°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.70-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.23 Å. Tm is bonded to six Cl atoms to form TmCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-46°. There are a spread of Tm-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.61 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Tm atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Tm trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Tm atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Tm trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Tm atom.
